features_delivered.J430_UNIFIED_CONSUMER_SYSTEM: A shared responsive spacing, typography, surface, control, focus and motion system now unifies the concierge, cinema, campus, deals, lunch and VietQR modules in both dark and light themes without removing functionality.
features_delivered.J429_TRUE_LIGHT_MODE: The header toggle now propagates theme state through body and application shell, with a complete warm Ivory and Champagne light-token layer, persisted preference and matching browser theme color.
features_delivered.J405_FULL_DOM_PRESERVATION: All 12 J403 core modules remain present and functional; no feature blocks were deleted or collapsed.
features_delivered.PINNACLE_ROYAL_FOREST_GOLD_SYSTEM: Unified #0A110D and #141E17 surfaces, Champagne Gold hairlines and typography, solid premium controls, zero legacy neon green and zero dashed UI borders.
features_delivered.OFFICIAL_BRAND_ASSETS: Header uses the official JT Gold monogram vector geometry; JayT Pass uses the official front and back name-card artwork in a two-sided 3D flip interaction with a local identity QR.
features_delivered.KTX_VOUCHER_TERMINAL: Three-second direct-link parser opens the official marketplace source and never invents voucher codes or discount claims.
features_delivered.COUNTER_QUICK_DOCK: Persistent bottom action dock retains Metiz, Galaxy, lunch comparator and split-bill shortcuts with sub-30ms response.
features_delivered.W7_SAFE_LINK_INSPECTOR: Allowlisted marketplace URL inspection extracts public item and shop identifiers when present and calculates a three-layer stack exclusively from user-entered values; no hidden-voucher scraping or private API calls.
features_delivered.J406_PRIVATE_CONCIERGE: A compact premium front surface led by the official JayT Pass, verified horizontal cinema and local-brand horizons, and a safe marketplace-link terminal.
features_delivered.J407_PASS_FLIP_CORRECTION: JayT Pass swaps front and back states without mirrored backface transforms; the QR remains centered inside the card boundary.
features_delivered.J407_RESPONSIVE_DOCK: The 56px cashier dock is fixed and thumb-reachable on mobile, and removed entirely from desktop layout.
features_delivered.J407_UTILITY_RESTORATION: Campus Dock, seven-day cinema schedule, user-driven three-app lunch comparator and split-bill/VietQR utility are restored as visible premium sections while the 30-card dorm grid stays out of the primary visual flow.
features_delivered.J407_SAFE_VOUCHER_GUIDANCE: Quick terminal chips identify shop, marketplace and freeship layers for users to verify in official apps; no voucher code or discount value is invented.
features_delivered.J408_EDITORIAL_HIERARCHY: The hero and utility sections use borderless editorial spacing, restrained hairlines and differentiated surfaces instead of repetitive boxed dashboard cards.
features_delivered.J408_DIGITAL_METAL_PASS: The official two-sided pass floats over the velvet background with pointer-responsive light reflection, reduced-motion support and an unmirrored QR back.
features_delivered.J408_AMBIENT_BRAND_MONOGRAMS: Five local-chain cards carry distinct recognizable monograms and restrained brand-colored ambient glows.
features_delivered.J408_CONSUMER_COPY: Technical explanatory language is replaced with concise concierge-oriented Vietnamese copy.
features_delivered.J410_DANANG_ATMOSPHERE: The locally stored Han River night photograph anchors an atmospheric city canvas behind the editorial hero.
features_delivered.J410_LOCAL_PLACE_IDENTITY: Hòa Khánh, Hải Châu, the Han River and recorded branch-locality text give the interface an explicit Da Nang reading path.
features_delivered.J410_TEN_BRAND_BADGES: Ten cashier-registry brands use existing vector iconography or semantic symbols, distinct accent lighting and recorded local address text.
features_delivered.J411_NAMECARD_REMOVAL: The personal Name Card and flip interaction are removed from the public Hero DOM.
features_delivered.J411_CITY_PULSE_RADAR: A time-aware Dragon Bridge city radar presents direct cinema, lunch, counter and split-bill actions.
features_delivered.J420_BRAND_DISCIPLINE: The public identity is JAYT ĐÀ NẴNG with the Vietnamese positioning line Cẩm nang tiện ích & đời sống số; the retired English template slogan is absent.
features_delivered.J420_QUIET_LUXURY_SYSTEM: Royal Forest and charcoal surfaces, 25-percent Champagne hairlines and metallic value typography are applied in place without removing any core module.
features_delivered.J420_DRAGON_BRIDGE_HERO: A locally hosted Dragon Bridge night image uses a 35-percent #0E1611 glass overlay and contains no personal name card.
features_delivered.J421_EDITORIAL_HERO: Editorial edge-to-edge Dragon Bridge sunset/night hero with fire breathing, directional gradient vignette, zero opaque glass box, and kicker JAYT ĐÀ NẴNG · NHỊP SỐNG HÔM NAY.
features_delivered.J421_CTA_HIERARCHY: One prominent filled Champagne Gold CTA button for the dynamic city pulse action, with secondary actions refined as ghost chips.
features_delivered.J421_HEADER_POSITIONING: Positioning subtitle 'Cẩm nang tiện ích & đời sống số' explicitly preserved and visible across mobile and desktop viewports.
features_delivered.J421_CHAMPAGNE_DOCK_SVGS: All bottom dock emojis replaced with bespoke monochrome Champagne Gold vector SVGs for Metiz, Galaxy, lunch and split bill.
features_delivered.J421_CONCIERGE_CONTINUITY: Eliminated the 100px isolated gap and harsh border between Hero and verified cinema tickets for seamless visual flow.
features_delivered.J422_MOBILE_HEADLINE_SCALE: Hero headline uses clamp(28px, 7.8vw, 33px) and 1.22 line height below 760px for stronger city-image breathing room.
features_delivered.J422_MOBILE_CTA_GRID: One full-width primary action sits above three equal-width secondary shortcuts in a stable three-column mobile grid.
features_delivered.J425_LIVE_CITY_PULSE: Static editorial headline ĐÀ NẴNG — NHỊP PHỐ & ĐẶC QUYỀN QUẦY with four interactive city daypart selectors.
features_delivered.J425_COASTAL_WARMTH: Velvet forest and charcoal depth pair with Champagne hairlines and a restrained Han River sunset accent.
features_delivered.J425_LOCAL_BRAND_AXIS: The first five cashier cards map Highlands Bạch Đằng, Phê La Nguyễn Văn Linh, Phúc Long 2 Tháng 9, Metiz Helio and Galaxy Điện Biên Phủ.
features_delivered.J425_DEBOXED_MODULES: Core utilities use transparent editorial sections and differentiated metal surfaces instead of repeated gray dashboard boxes.
features_delivered.J426_PRODUCTION_POLISH: Action hierarchy with 1 primary CTA and 3 compact shortcuts, mobile headline scaled for Dragon Bridge breathing room, slender text-tabs for 4 dayparts, 38px gold monogram + 18px brand title, and tightened hero-to-cinema transition gap.
features_delivered.J427_MASTER_POLISH: Removed redundant locality sub-line, enhanced description contrast text-shadow for sunset/fire clarity, and transformed cinema cards into luxury ticket stubs with laser notches and dashed perforation.
features_delivered.J428_EDITORIAL_ARCHITECTURE: Unified vertical rhythm with 35-45% spacing compression, redesigned lower modules with transparent velvet surfaces and Champagne hairlines (purging blue/green dashboard boxes and emoji titles), golden 5/7 desktop hero ratio (42% content, 58% landscape), Campus Dock anchored directly to Deals Vault, and 14.5px+ body text hierarchy.
features_delivered.J431_POLISH_SPRINT: High-contrast amber-brown cinema text in Light Mode (#7A5418), redesigned editorial scroll cue pill badges (Vuốt ngang xem tiếp →), elevated bottom dock in Light Mode with 1.5px border and +15% multi-tier shadow depth, and polished hover/focus states for all form inputs in Lunch Arbitrage and Split Bill modules.
features_delivered.J432_EDITORIAL_DAYLIGHT: Purged nested dark dashboard panels across Cinema Schedule, Lunch Arbitrage, and Split Bill modules into pristine Ivory surfaces with Forest Velvet result highlighting; replaced murky gray KTX box with #FFFDF8 card surface; heightened Campus ribbon contrast to #6B4A18; compressed vertical spacing by 25-30%; unified F&B brand card proportions; and standardized entire form system with #C9B58D borders.
features_delivered.J433_DESKTOP_PROPORTIONS_AND_CTA_HIERARC: Expanded desktop max-width to 1300px (88-90% width utilization); scaled Hero content and headline by 10-12%; compressed section vertical gaps by 12-16px; balanced Lunch Arbitrage to 40/60 grid; enlarged desktop descriptions and input labels; and formalized a distinct 3-tier CTA hierarchy (Tier 1 Gold Filled, Tier 2 Champagne Outline, Tier 3 Text-Link).
features_delivered.J457_MONOLITHIC_CANVAS: One uninterrupted #0D1612 to #070C0A canvas and #16221B card surface contract removes all alternating cream section bands in both stored theme states.
features_delivered.J457_NAMECARD_PURGE: The public JayT Pass and personal-card banner is removed; the footer contains only the JayT corporate legal identity and local product positioning.
features_delivered.J457_MOBILE_POCKET_TOOLS: Lunch comparison and integer split tools remain in the DOM and are invoked from the fixed mobile dock as bottom-sheet utilities instead of expanding the primary mobile feed.
features_delivered.J460_TOTAL_SURFACE_CONTRACT: A final component-level surface contract forces legacy ticket, brand, calculator, split and SKU components onto #141F18; canvas is #0B120E, inputs are #0E1712, and no ivory component surface is allowed.
features_delivered.J465_MONOLITHIC_SURFACE: A single cached runtime stylesheet entrypoint preserves the established cascade while applying one Forest and Champagne surface contract to cards, controls and utility modules; the authored Dragon Bridge hero image and all functional DOM remain intact.
